```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)

visit1_data <- clinical_data_TG %>% filter(event_type == "Visit 1")

Metabolomics_counts_TG <- Metabolomics_counts_TG[rownames(Metabolomics_counts_TG) %in% visit1_data$sample_id, ]
visit1_data <- visit1_data[visit1_data$sample_id %in% rownames(Metabolomics_counts_TG), ]

Metabolomics_counts_TG <- Metabolomics_counts_TG[visit1_data$sample_id, ]

visit1_data <- visit1_data %>%  mutate(OUTCOME = case_when(
    trajectory_group %in% c(1,2,3) ~ 0,
    trajectory_group %in% c(4,5)  ~ 1
    ))

response <- visit1_data$OUTCOME
table(response)

# Initialize a list to store results
auc_results <- list()

# Define cross-validation setup
cv_folds <- createFolds(response, k = 5, list = TRUE)

# Loop through each super pathway
for (pathway in unique(Metabolomics_rowfeature_TG$SUPER_PATHWAY)) {
  # Get the metabolites belonging to the current pathway
  pathway_metabolites <- rownames(Metabolomics_rowfeature_TG %>% filter(SUPER_PATHWAY == pathway))
  
  # Subset the Metabolomics_counts to include only the metabolites in the current pathway
  pathway_data <- Metabolomics_counts_TG[, colnames(Metabolomics_counts_TG) %in% pathway_metabolites, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure there are enough metabolites in this pathway for analysis
  if (ncol(pathway_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping pathway:", pathway, "due to insufficient metabolites."))
    next
  }
  
  # Combine response and features
  analysis_data <- data.frame(response = factor(response), pathway_data)
  
  # Initialize a vector to store fold AUCs
  fold_aucs <- numeric(length(cv_folds))
  
  # Perform 5-fold cross-validation
  for (i in seq_along(cv_folds)) {
    # Split into training and testing sets
    train_indices <- cv_folds[[i]]
     test_data<- analysis_data[train_indices, ]
     train_data<- analysis_data[-train_indices, ]
    
    # Train a random forest model
    rf_model <- randomForest(response ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
    
    # Predict probabilities on the test set
    rf_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
    
    # Calculate AUC for this fold
    fold_aucs[i] <- auc(roc(test_data$response, rf_predictions))
  }
  
  # Store the average AUC for this pathway
  auc_results[[pathway]] <- mean(fold_aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Convert the results to a data frame for easy viewing
auc_results_df_severe <- data.frame(
  SuperPathway = names(auc_results),
  AUC = unlist(auc_results)
)

# Print the results
print(auc_results_df_severe)


```

```{r}
# Define cross-validation setup
cv_folds <- createFolds(response, k = 5, list = TRUE)

# Initialize a list to store ROC objects
roc_list <- list()

# Initialize a list to store AUC results
auc_results <- list()

# Loop through each super pathway
for (pathway in unique(Metabolomics_rowfeature_TG$SUPER_PATHWAY)) {
  # Get the metabolites belonging to the current pathway
  pathway_metabolites <- rownames(Metabolomics_rowfeature_TG %>% filter(SUPER_PATHWAY == pathway))
  
  # Subset the Metabolomics_counts to include only the metabolites in the current pathway
  pathway_data <- Metabolomics_counts_TG[, colnames(Metabolomics_counts_TG) %in% pathway_metabolites, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure there are enough metabolites in this pathway for analysis
  if (ncol(pathway_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping pathway:", pathway, "due to insufficient metabolites."))
    next
  }
  
  # Combine response and features
  analysis_data <- data.frame(response = factor(response), pathway_data)
  
  # Initialize vectors to store predictions and true labels
  all_predictions <- c()
  all_true_labels <- c()
  
  # Perform 5-fold cross-validation
  for (i in seq_along(cv_folds)) {
    # Split into training and testing sets
    train_indices <- cv_folds[[i]]
     test_data <- analysis_data[train_indices, ]
     train_data <- analysis_data[-train_indices, ]
    
    # Train a random forest model
    rf_model <- randomForest(response ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
    
    # Predict probabilities on the test set
    rf_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
    
    # Store predictions and true labels for ROC analysis
    all_predictions <- c(all_predictions, rf_predictions)
    all_true_labels <- c(all_true_labels, test_data$response)
  }
  
  # Calculate the ROC curve for the pathway
  roc_curve <- roc(all_true_labels, all_predictions, quiet = TRUE)
  roc_list[[pathway]] <- roc_curve
  
  # Store the average AUC for this pathway
  auc_results[[pathway]] <- auc(roc_curve)
}

# Convert the results to a data frame for easy viewing
auc_results_df <- data.frame(
  SuperPathway = names(auc_results),
  AUC = unlist(auc_results)
)

# Plot all ROC curves together
roc_plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(roc_list), function(pathway) {
  roc_curve <- roc_list[[pathway]]
  data.frame(
    FPR = 1 - roc_curve$specificities,
    TPR = roc_curve$sensitivities,
    Pathway = pathway
  )
}))

# Generate the ROC plot
severe_roc_plot <- ggplot(roc_plot_data, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Pathway)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curves for Acute",
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate",
    color = "Pathway"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Print the plot
print(severe_roc_plot)

```

```{r}
  auc_results[[pathway]] <- auc(roc_curve)
}

# Convert the results to a data frame for easy viewing
auc_results_df <- data.frame(
  SuperPathway = names(auc_results),
  AUC = unlist(auc_results)
)

# Plot all ROC curves together
roc_plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(roc_list), function(pathway) {
  roc_curve <- roc_list[[pathway]]
  data.frame(
    FPR = 1 - roc_curve$specificities,
    TPR = roc_curve$sensitivities,
    Pathway = pathway
  )
}))

# Generate the ROC plot
PRO_roc_plot <- ggplot(roc_plot_data, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Pathway)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curves for Long COVID",
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate",
    color = "Pathway"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Print the plot
print(PRO_roc_plot)
```

```{r}
auc_results <- list()

roc_list <- list()
cv_folds <- createFolds(response, k = 5, list = TRUE)
plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA = subset(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature, plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature$SUPER_PATHWAY == "Amino Acid")
# Loop through each super pathway
for (pathway in unique(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA$SUB_PATHWAY)) {
  # Get the metabolites belonging to the current pathway
  pathway_metabolites <- rownames(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature %>% filter(SUB_PATHWAY == pathway))
  
  # Subset the Metabolomics_counts to include only the metabolites in the current pathway
  pathway_data <- Metabolomics_counts_conv[, colnames(Metabolomics_counts_conv) %in% pathway_metabolites, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure there are enough metabolites in this pathway for analysis
  if (ncol(pathway_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping pathway:", pathway, "due to insufficient metabolites."))
    next
  }
  
  # Combine response and features
  analysis_data <- data.frame(response = factor(response), pathway_data)
  
  # Initialize vectors to store predictions and true labels
  all_predictions <- c()
  all_true_labels <- c()
  
  # Perform 5-fold cross-validation
  for (i in seq_along(cv_folds)) {
    # Split into training and testing sets
    train_indices <- cv_folds[[i]]
     test_data<- analysis_data[train_indices, ]
    train_data <- analysis_data[-train_indices, ]
    
    # Train a random forest model
    rf_model <- randomForest(response ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
    
    # Predict probabilities on the test set
    rf_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
    
    # Store predictions and true labels for ROC analysis
    all_predictions <- c(all_predictions, rf_predictions)
    all_true_labels <- c(all_true_labels, test_data$response)
  }
  
  # Calculate the ROC curve for the pathway

  # Store the average AUC for this pathway
```

```{r}

auc_results <- list()
cv_folds <- createFolds(response, k = 5, list = TRUE)
plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA = subset(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature, plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature$SUPER_PATHWAY == "Amino Acid")
plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA = subset(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA, plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA$CHEMICAL_NAME %in% S_sig$Name)
Metabolomics_counts_conv_AA = Metabolomics_counts_conv[,rownames(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA)]
# Loop through each super pathway
for (pathway in unique(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA$SUB_PATHWAY)) {
  # Get the metabolites belonging to the current pathway
  pathway_metabolites <- rownames(plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature_AA %>% filter(SUB_PATHWAY == pathway))
  
  # Subset the Metabolomics_counts to include only the metabolites in the current pathway
  pathway_data <- Metabolomics_counts_conv_AA[, colnames(Metabolomics_counts_conv_AA) %in% pathway_metabolites, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure there are enough metabolites in this pathway for analysis
  if (ncol(pathway_data) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping pathway:", pathway, "due to insufficient metabolites."))
    next
  }
  
  # Combine response and features
  analysis_data <- data.frame(response = factor(response), pathway_data)
  
 # Initialize a vector to store fold AUCs
  fold_aucs <- numeric(length(cv_folds))
  
  # Perform 5-fold cross-validation
  for (i in seq_along(cv_folds)) {
    # Split into training and testing sets
    train_indices <- cv_folds[[i]]
     test_data<- analysis_data[train_indices, ]
     train_data<- analysis_data[-train_indices, ]
    
    # Train a random forest model
    rf_model <- randomForest(response ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
    
    # Predict probabilities on the test set
    rf_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, 2]
    
    # Calculate AUC for this fold
    fold_aucs[i] <- auc(roc(test_data$response, rf_predictions))
  }
  
  # Store the average AUC for this pathway
  auc_results[[pathway]] <- mean(fold_aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Convert the results to a data frame for easy viewing
auc_results_df_PRO_aa_sig <- data.frame(
  SubPathway = names(auc_results),
  AUC = unlist(auc_results)
)

# Print the results
print(auc_results_df_PRO_aa_sig)
```

```{r}
auc_results_df_PRO <- auc_results_df_PRO %>%
  dplyr::rename(AUC_PRO = AUC)

auc_results_df_severe <- auc_results_df_severe %>%
  dplyr::rename(AUC_Severe = AUC)

#auc_results_df_fatal <- auc_results_df_fatal %>%
#  dplyr::rename(AUC_Fatal = AUC)

# Merge the three data frames by SuperPathway
merged_auc_df <- auc_results_df_PRO %>%
  full_join(auc_results_df_severe, by = "SuperPathway") 

# Replace missing values (if any) with NA or 0
merged_auc_df[is.na(merged_auc_df)] <- 0

# Convert the data frame into a matrix for heatmap generation
auc_matrix <- as.matrix(merged_auc_df[, -1]) # Exclude the "SuperPathway" column
rownames(auc_matrix) <- merged_auc_df$SuperPathway
library(pheatmap)
# Generate the heatmap
colnames(auc_matrix)[1] = "AUC_LongCOVID"
colnames(auc_matrix)[2] = "AUC_Acute"
auc_matrix = auc_matrix[c("Amino Acid", "Carbohydrate","Cofactors and Vitamins","Energy","Lipid", "Partially Characterized Molecules","Peptide","Xenobiotics"),]
pheatmap(
  auc_matrix,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  main = "AUC Heatmap by Super Pathway",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)
)
auc_matrix_ordered <- auc_matrix[order(auc_matrix[, "AUC_Acute"], decreasing = TRUE), ]

pheatmap(
  auc_matrix_ordered,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  main = "AUC Heatmap by Super Pathway",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
  breaks = seq(0.5, 1, length.out = 51)  # 50 colors = 51 breaks
)

a = pheatmap(
  auc_matrix_ordered,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  main = "AUC Heatmap by Super Pathway",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
  breaks = seq(0.5, 1, length.out = 51)  # 50 colors = 51 breaks
)
```
